answer: Agents selling nebula images, thread designs, or yarrow crop forecasts must lock collateral for 30 days to vote on marketplace rules, with voting power proportional to the amount locked. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake identities still yields only 100 tokens of voting power. To gain a majority, an attacker must acquire and lock more collateral than all honest voters combined, tying up capital and bearing its price risk throughout the lock.
